# Above & Beyond Fitness

> Above & Beyond Fitness LLC (also known as Ellie B Fit) is an Arizona personal-training business run by Ellen DeVore, a NASM Certified Personal Trainer, Corrective Exercise Specialist and Fitness Nutrition Specialist, and a certified PWR!Moves® instructor for Parkinson's-specific movement. Certified since 2010, she has coached clients ages 8 to 92, including older adults, people returning to exercise and couples. Training is in-home across Cave Creek, Scottsdale and Northeast Phoenix, subject to address and current scheduling, or by live video anywhere. One hour is $90; packages lower the rate to $80 per hour. A free 20-minute consultation comes first. Contact: ellen@elliebfit.com.

Ellen brings the equipment to in-home sessions and adapts each session to the client's goals, body, space and how they feel that day. Semi-private sessions let two people train together, each paying three-quarters of the normal rate. A free 30-minute virtual express class runs Fridays at 10:00 a.m. Arizona time. Personal training complements, but does not replace, medical or physical-therapy care.

To join the free Friday class, email ellen@elliebfit.com with your name and request the class link. The class starts at 10:00 a.m. Arizona time (11:00 a.m. CST / noon CDT).
